purpose: Controlled same-ASR-draft replay regression inputs for V7 decode-step comparison.
scope_note: All selected material comes from the previously measured 2506-item benchmark pool; this is a known-success regression set plus negative controls, not unseen validation. No reference/gold text is included. source_text is reconstructed from the old audio-arm raw_text using validated entity_audio_repair changes, or copied directly from raw_text when there were no changes.

selection.changed_examples: All old results.jsonl audio-arm records with entity_audio_repair.change_count > 0; each change is checked at canonical-position adjusted by preceding length deltas, inverse-applied right-to-left, and forward-applied from recovered source offsets; both reconstruction assertions must reproduce old raw_text exactly.
selection.negative_controls: Select 32 metadata cohort=negative IDs outside changed set sorted by SHA256("review-step-controls:" + id); require old audio-arm change_count=0 and empty changes.
selection.output_order: Deterministic hash order for changed records, with controls interleaved after the first 32 changed records.

validation.changed_reconstruction_assertions: For every change, canonical substring at start + cumulative prior length deltas matched old raw_text; inverse replacements reconstructed source_text; source observed spans matched at original start/end; forward replacements reconstructed old raw_text exactly.

v7_design: Only second-pass replay ASR decode step changes from 2 to 10 seconds; first-pass ASR remains 2 seconds. source_text is the same old ASR draft, not gold/reference.
